title: Clay Fest 2026 Live Raku Firings
how_to_join: Arrive at least 60 minutes before the scheduled firing time. No pre-signup required.
cost_text: Purchase a pre-made vessel from Sam Frey
source_quote: Raku firings will take place at 11:30am, 12:30pm, 1:30pm, and 2:30pm at Booth E. To participate, arrive at least 60 minutes before the scheduled firing time. No pre-signup is required
evidence_sentence: The raku firing schedule page lists four raku firing sessions on September 19th where participants glaze and fire pre-made vessels.
evidence_quote: Raku firings will take place at 11:30am, 12:30pm, 1:30pm, and 2:30pm
summary: On September 19, 2026, Clay Fest offers public raku firings where you can decorate a pre-made pot and watch it fire. Four sessions run 11:30am–2:30pm; arrive an hour early, no signup required.
